value.rationale: A natural numerical-node robustness gap is resolved: a single fixed positive mesh-fraction displacement violates existing all-node sufficient conditions but provably preserves logarithmic amplification with an exact strictly increased coefficient and opposite-side norming displacement. The result quantitatively distinguishes local defects from arbitrary near-collisions and has a direct interpretation for polynomial interpolation stability, without claiming whole-algorithm performance.
